name: -16 AN Fitting Bulkhead Straight
title: -16 AN Fitting Bulkhead Straight
description:
The -16 AN Fitting Bulkhead Straight is engineered for demanding high-performance automotive fluid systems. ColorFittings AN Union Bulkhead Fittings are precision CNC-machined adapters designed to pass AN lines securely through firewalls, panels, fuel cells, and chassis components. Engineered for high-performance fuel, oil, coolant, transmission, brake, and power steering systems, these AN bulkhead unions provide a secure, leak-free 37-degree flare seal on both sides of the panel.

Technical Specifications:
• Origin: Precision CNC-machined in the USA.
• Material & Finish: 6061-T6 Billet Aluminum with an anodized finish for maximum corrosion resistance.
